title: Goldreich–Levin output failure bound
statement:
Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f:
\{\pm1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$ be a Boolean function, and let $0<\tau\le 1$ be a rational threshold. Run the Goldreich–Levin query algorithm with target $f$, and for each $U\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$ write $\widehat f(U)=\mathbb E_x[f(x)\prod_{i\in U}x_i]$, where $x$ is uniform on the Boolean cube. The probability that its output fails to be a state whose active set contains every $U$ with $|\widehat f(U)|\ge\tau$, contains only sets $U$ with $|\widehat f(U)|>\tau/2$, and has cardinality at most both $\lceil4/\tau^2\rceil$ and $4/\tau^2$, is at most $1/10$.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
